sources.title: Warhounds on Steam
sources.version_boundary: English Steam listing observed after the August 11, 2026 release

claims.statement: Official material describes a broad selection of weapons, gear, abilities, and upgradable equipment.
Named tactical tools include drones, combat scanners, smoke, and optical camouflage.
Steam describes true ballistics and explicitly contrasts the combat with fake random-number outcomes.
Cover can be destroyed, high ground matters, and the battlefields support vertical play.
Warhounds uses cone-based overwatch and visible lines of fire as tactical systems.

unknowns: The checked official sources do not provide a complete launch weapon list, damage table, armor formula, range table, or universal best-weapon ranking.
The guide uses weapon-role categories and tactical questions instead of fabricated numerical tiers.
Any claim about exact hit resolution needs current-build testing beyond this evidence pack.
